At the meeting held on 20260527_14:00, Turalyon and the residents discussed several strategies to manage and mitigate noise during the ongoing construction of the garden. Specifically, Turalyon proposed limiting noisy activities from 2-3 pm and suggested putting up temporary barriers or using quieter tools during that timeframe. The residents expressed their agreement with these ideas and shared additional suggestions. Malfurion Stormrage recommended notifying residents a day in advance about any particularly loud work, which could help them plan accordingly. Arthas Menethil suggested posting updates in the chat or placing a notice board at the entrance of the garden to inform residents of ongoing work. 

Additionally, Muradin Bronzebeard proposed using sound-absorbing materials for benches or play areas, while Rexxar Remar suggested moving play areas further away from the construction site to provide a quieter spot for children. Grom Hellscream recommended incorporating tall shrubs or trees along the perimeter of the garden as a natural barrier to reduce noise. 

The residents also considered planting native species that could provide noise reduction and enhance the aesthetic appeal of the garden. Li Hua proposed setting up seating areas that blend well with the surroundings, while Chae Song-hwa suggested a rustic design for the seating areas. 

In summary, the meeting focused on limiting noisy activities, notifying residents, using sound-absorbing materials, and implementing sustainable landscaping practices to reduce noise levels and improve the overall experience for residents.
